en: Leave the game? Unsecured loot stays behind.
One down before custody. Higher stakes, same pay.
No restarts. Fail and the contract is gone.
Fill empty slots with crew AI
Hold {key} to pick up the bag
Hold {key} to use the doctor bag
Hold {key} to take a body bag
Clean job. Nobody knew we were there.
Stealth bonus banked for your next job: +{pct}%
A compact nine-millimetre service pistol. Light, quiet to carry, forgiving to learn.
Lacquered gold over a long, patient face. It has seen worse jobs than yours.
Turns gunfire into a polite cough. Heavier at the muzzle and a little less punch.
A red dot for quicker shots on target. Adds bulk under a jacket.
More rounds between reloads. Sticks out of the grip, slows the swap.
Small, quiet and always in the pocket.
No armor, all elegance. Nobody looks twice at a good suit.
Thin ballistic panels that vanish under a coat.
The standard compromise between coverage and mobility.
Reinforced panels front and back. You will feel it on the stairs.
Shoulder-to-hip protection. Hard to hide, harder to put down.
Ceramic plates for people who expect a long day.
Full plate carrier for walking through the front door. Requires training to move in.
Patches the crew up and resets their downs. Two uses.
A heavy bag of spare magazines for the whole crew.
Holds three body bags for a tidy crew.
Rings, necklaces and watches in a padded bag.
Heavy and awkward. Out of sight is out of mind.
Vossberg keeps the good stones in the back and the cameras in the front. Odile wants the back.
Hold out until the van arrives
Alright, you're in. Keep the masks in your pockets and look like you belong.
Take your time. Count the cameras, count the guards, and try to look bored.
Mask's on. No more pretending to shop.
Faces covered. From here on, it counts.
His pager's going. Somebody pick that up and be convincing.
Pager. Answer it before his boss gets curious.
That's the last one they'll buy.
That was your last free pass. No more bodies with radios.
Too many check-ins. Dispatch knows something's wrong. Here comes the noise.
Nobody believes a fifth all-clear. They're calling it in.
Silence on the pager. They're sending company.
Someone found a body. That's going to be hard to explain.
A body's been spotted. Get ready.
You're on tape. Somebody's watching that monitor.
And there's the alarm. Quiet's over, so let's be quick instead.
Alarm's up. Police are on their way. Plan B, everyone.
Drill's on. It'll take a while, so get comfortable.
Drill's stopped. Somebody give it some encouragement.
The drill's jammed again. Cheap hardware, I know.
Drill's through. Go see what we paid for.
They're gathering outside. Find cover and top up your ammo.
It's gone quiet out there. That's never good. Get ready.
Assault's starting. Stay close and stay alive.
They're pulling back. Use the breather.
Assault's thinning out. Breathe, reload, keep working.
Quiet for now. Get the work done before they regroup.
They're regrouping. You have a minute, maybe two.
Another one in the van. Good.
Van's here. Leave whenever you're ready, or stay and get greedy.
Your ride is waiting. I'd use it.
Crew member down. Don't leave them there.
They've got one of you. We'll get them back, but finish the job first.
One in custody. I'll start working on a trade.
That's a clean exit. Drinks are on the contract.
Done. Everyone home and the money's moving.
That one's gone. We'll talk about it later.
Pull out. There's nothing left worth getting caught for.
In and out and nobody the wiser. That's how it's supposed to go.
Not a single shot fired. I'm almost impressed.
Drill's stuck. Need hands on it.
We're loud. Masks on, guns up.
Hit hard. Somebody get me up.
Civilian down. That's on our tab.
Loud it is. Try to keep up.
I'm down. Not my best moment.
On your feet, I'm not carrying you.
Swapping mags. Give me a sec.
Drill's dead. Kicking it back on.
Here we go. Loud and proud.
His pager's beeping, I'm on it.
Bagging the body, gimme a second.
Can't get up, need a medic!
I got you, I got you.

+1 concealment. Armor slows you 15% less. You earn 45% more experience.
Unlocks the armor bag, so you can change armor mid-job. Ammo pickups give 135% of the normal amount.
Your weapons deal 5% more damage. You use doctor bags 20% faster.
Deck complete: PAYDAY card drops are 10% more likely to be a better item.
Keeps the whole crew standing. Every buff in this deck reaches your teammates, and hostages make everyone tougher.
Your crew takes 8% less damage. Below half health, you take 16% less instead.
You and your crew get 50% more stamina. Your shouts reach 25% farther. Within 18 m of an enemy you take 8% less damage.
Your crew gets 10% more health. You get 20% more in total.
You get 10% more armor in total. Your crew gets 5% more armor.
For each hostage (up to 4) you and your crew get 6% more health and 12% more stamina. With at least one hostage, the crew takes 8% less damage.
Doubles your health, pulls fire off the crew and slowly patches you up.
Near your crew, enemies are 15% more likely to aim at you. Health bonus rises to 20%.
Your gunfire can make nearby enemies panic for a moment.
Health bonus rises to 100%. You regenerate 3% of your health every 5 seconds.
More armor, and a breath of invulnerability every time it breaks.
Your armor recovers 10% faster. When your armor breaks you cannot lose health for 2 seconds (once every 15 seconds).
Armor bonus rises to 35%. You and your crew recover armor 10% faster.
Hard to pin down: stacked dodge, quick hands, rounds that punch through armor.
Your dodge chance rises by 15 points.
Near your crew, enemies are 15% less likely to aim at you.
Your dodge chance rises by another 15 points.
Your dodge chance rises by another 15 points.
Every weapon has a 25% chance to pierce armor. You swap weapons 80% faster.
Dodge in a vest. Its bonuses only work while you wear ballistic armor.
Your dodge chance rises by 15 points.
In a ballistic vest: +5 dodge and 20% more armor.
In a ballistic vest: +15 dodge and 40% more armor in total.
In a ballistic vest: +25 dodge and 65% more armor in total.
Every kill feeds your armor, and it always comes back after a break.
Each kill restores 30 armor (at most once a second). You get 10% more armor.
Melee kills restore 10% health (at most once a second). Within 18 m of an enemy you take 8% less damage.
Kills within 18 m restore another 30 armor. Armor bonus rises to 20%.
Kills within 18 m have a 75% chance to make nearby enemies panic (at most once a second).
Your armor recovers 10% faster, and it always starts coming back 1.5 seconds after it breaks, whatever is happening.
Quiet hands for quiet jobs, and a slippery target when it goes loud.
Your dodge chance rises by 20 points.
You bag bodies 20% faster. Standing still or crouching makes enemies 10% less likely to aim at you.
+5 dodge. You pick locks 20% faster. The still/crouch bonus rises to 15%.
+5 dodge. You answer pagers 10% faster. The still/crouch bonus rises to 20%.
Standing still or crouching makes your armor recover 20% faster. You move 10% faster while crouched.
Built for the close fight: tougher in a crowd, brutal with a melee chain.
With 3 or more enemies around you, you take 12% less damage. Each melee hit within 1 second of the last deals 10 times its damage.
Within 18 m of an enemy you take 8% less damage.
Close-range reduction rises to 16%. Your melee chain lasts 7 seconds.
A melee hit restores 20% of your health (once every 10 seconds).
Hurting enemies heals you over time. Only works in a suit or light vest.
Damaging an enemy heals 1 health every 0.3 s for 3 s. Stacks, at most one new stack every 1.5 s. Suit or light vest only.
Each stack now heals 2 health per tick. You get 20% more health.
Each stack now heals 3 per tick. +10% chance to pierce armor.
Each stack now heals 4 per tick. Health bonus rises to 40%.
Stacks last 4.2 s. Armor-pierce bonus rises to 20%.
No armor. Damage arrives slowly, and a flask makes the rest go away.
Unlocks the flask (throwable slot). 75% of incoming damage arrives over 12 s instead. Drinking cancels all pending damage (10 s cooldown, 1 s faster per kill).
Your armor is converted into health.
If you take no damage for 4 s, all pending damage is cancelled.
Below 35% health, each kill cuts 2 s from the flask cooldown instead of 1.
When pending damage is cancelled you heal 50% of what was left.
Trade health for armor that keeps trickling back in the middle of a fight.
Your armor regenerates in small ticks during combat instead of all at once. When armor breaks you cannot lose health for 2 s (once every 15 s).
Half of your health is converted into armor (100%).
Dealing damage restores 30 armor (once every 1.5 s).
Crew kills bank health while your armor holds; you cash it in when armor comes back.
While your armor is up, every crew kill banks 4 health. When your armor breaks and starts to recover, you get the bank. The bank's size depends on your armor.
Each kill banks 8 health. You get 10% more health.
The bank holds 50% more. Health bonus rises to 20%. +15 dodge.
Each kill banks 12 health. Health bonus rises to 40%.
Each kill speeds up your armor recovery; lighter armor gains more. Resets when armor recovers.
Ammo boxes become med kits, and you share both with the crew.
Ammo pickups also heal you 16-24 health (once every 3 s), 20% more for each teammate healthier than you (up to 3).
Your ammo pickups give each teammate half a pickup (once every 5 s). You get 20% more health.
Teammates heal for half of what your ammo pickups heal you. Health bonus rises to 40%.
Ammo pickups heal 16 more in total.
An injector that turns incoming fire into healing, if you can take the heat.
Unlocks the injector (throwable slot). For 6 s you heal 75% of the damage you take (30 s cooldown, 1 s faster per kill).
Health bonus rises to 20%. Nearby enemies prefer to shoot you while the injector is active.
Health bonus rises to 40%. Below half health the injector heals 25% more.
Health bonus rises to 80%. Every 50 health the injector heals while you are at full health cuts 1 s from its cooldown.
Spend {need} points in lower tiers of this subtree first ({have} spent).
Take 30% less damage while reviving a crew member and for 5 s afterwards.
Crew members you revive get up with 30% more health.
Deploy First Aid Kits and Doctor Bags 50% faster.
Crew members who use your First Aid Kits or Doctor Bags take 10% less damage for 120 s.
Crew members you revive take 30% less damage for 5 s.
Carry 3 more First Aid Kits. A crew member who goes down within 5 m of one of your placed kits uses it automatically and stays up (at most once every 20 s).
Your Doctor Bags have 2 more charges (4 each).
Revive crew members 100% faster. Shouting at a crew member gives them 20% more movement and reload speed for 10 s.
Shout at a downed crew member up to 9 m away to revive them instantly. Once every 20 s.
Carry 4 more cable ties. Tie hostages 75% faster.
You and your crew absorb 5 damage from every hit for each hostage you hold, up to 8 hostages. Crew-wide; does not stack with another Zip & Tie.
You can keep 2 converted enemies at once.
Your shouts can make low-tier police surrender. Hold the shout on a surrendered non-special enemy to convert them into an ally (loud only, 1 at a time).
Converted allies deal 35% more damage, and converting takes 65% less time.
Your gunfire intimidates nearby civilians, and intimidated civilians stay down 50% longer.
When you go down, a hostage near you can revive you. Once per heist.
While you have a converted ally, you move 10% faster. Your converted allies take 45% less damage.
While you have a converted ally, you have 30% more health. Your converted allies take a further 54% less damage.
While you hold at least one hostage or converted ally, regenerate 1.5% health every 5 s.
The regeneration rises to 4.5% every 5 s.
+8 stability (8% less recoil) with all weapons.
+16 accuracy (16% tighter spread) while standing still.
Aim down sights 100% faster with all weapons and move at full speed while aiming.
+16 accuracy while moving with SMGs, assault rifles and sniper rifles.
+8 accuracy with SMGs, assault rifles and sniper rifles.
+12 more accuracy with SMGs, assault rifles and sniper rifles.
3 headshots within 6 s with an SMG, assault rifle or sniper rifle put 1 round back in the magazine.
Reload SMGs, assault rifles and sniper rifles 15% faster.
A headshot kill with one of them doubles your reload speed for 4 s.
Sniper rifle hits also deal 20% of their damage to every enemy within 1 m of the bullet's path.
If the hit is a headshot kill, the graze deals 100% of the damage.
When 3 or more enemies are within 18 m, deal 15% more damage for 7 s.
You also take 10% less damage for those 7 s.
Reload shotguns a further 17% faster (35% in total) and aim them down sights 125% faster.
+8 stability and 5% more damage with shotguns.
Shotgun damage rises to 15% more in total.
Shotgun damage starts falling off 50% further away.
Fire shotguns from the hip while sprinting.
Shotguns fire 35% faster from the hip.
A shotgun kill gives you 75% more shotgun damage for 20 s.
The bonus applies to all your weapons (a shotgun kill still triggers it). Swap weapons 80% faster.
Flashbangs blind you for 75% less time.
Taking damage no longer interrupts your interactions.
Your crew's armor regenerates 25% faster. Crew-wide; does not stack with another Shoulder Check.
Your hits can knock Bulwarks back: melee always, ranged with a chance that rises with weapon damage.
Each headshot restores 5 armor (at most once every 2 s).
Unlocks the Breacher Plate, the heaviest armor (170 armor, 1 concealment).
Pick up ammo from 50% further away.
Every 6th enemy you kill drops an extra ammo box.
Crew members who refill from your ammo bags don't use ammo for up to 5 s; the more they took, the longer.
The effect lasts up to 15 s longer.
Your rounds pierce Bulwark shields, but you carry 15% less ammo.
Your ammo bags hold 50% more ammo.
Carry 25% more ammo for all weapons.
Ammo boxes give 75% more ammo and have a 5% chance (+1% for every box without one) to hold a throwable.
Sentry guns cost 5% less of your ammo to deploy.
Your sentry guns get a protective shield.
Your sentry guns are 100% more accurate.
Your sentry guns turn 150% faster and carry 50% more ammo.
Sentry guns cost a further 5% less of your ammo to deploy.
Your sentry guns have 150% more health.
Switch your sentry guns to quiet mode: enemies are much less likely to target them.
Switch your sentry guns to armor-piercing rounds: 75% lower fire rate, 250% more damage, pierces enemies and shields.
Deploy and use all deployables 100% faster.
Carry a second deployable type (half the usual amount of it).
Fix drills and saws 25% faster and place trip mines 20% faster. Your drills and saws are silent: guards and civilians must see them to react.
Your drills and saws have a 10% chance to restart by themselves after jamming.
Your trip mines have a 30% larger blast radius.
Use trip mines as shaped charges on doors and safes.
Drill and saw timers are 15% shorter.
Carry 3 more trip mines (7 in total).
Your drills and saws have a further 20% chance to restart by themselves after jamming.
Hit a jammed drill or saw with your melee weapon for a 50% chance to restart it (one try per jam).
Your trip mines leave a 4 m wide fire for 10 s when they go off.
The fire lasts 10 s longer and covers a 50% larger area.
+8 accuracy (8% tighter spread) with all weapons.
+16 stability (16% less recoil) with all weapons.
Your shots have a 5% chance to stagger enemies (Wreckers and Commander Brandt are immune).
+12 accuracy when firing from the hip.
The accuracy penalty for moving is 20% smaller.
Killing 2 enemies with an automatic SMG, LMG, assault rifle or special weapon makes your next reload up to 100% faster (at least 40% for large magazines).
SMGs, LMGs and assault rifles hold 15 more rounds per magazine.
All your ranged weapons pierce body armor.
Automatic fire with SMGs, LMGs, assault rifles and special weapons applies 30% of the headshot bonus to body hits.
While casing, you are detected 25% more slowly and can mark guards and cameras.
Pick up small loot and items while casing. Small loot you pick up is worth 30% more.
Stand still for 3.5 s in stealth to mark every enemy within 10 m automatically.
Loop a camera for 25 s so it sees nothing (one camera at a time).
Pick locks 100% faster, and pick the locks of small safes.
ECM jams and ECM feedback last 25% longer.
Place an ECM on a keycard door (4 s) or an ATM (8 s) to open it. The ECM is used up.
ECM jams and feedback last a further 25% longer. Pagers of guards killed during a jam stay silent until it ends.
Sprint in any direction, and reload while sprinting.
While your armor is broken, your first shot on each enemy staggers it.
The effect lasts 6 s after your armor comes back.
When a Stinger tases you, there is a 30% chance it backfires and knocks the Stinger back.
Interact within 2 s of being tased to shock the Stinger and break free.
+1% dodge for every 3 points your detection risk is below 35, up to +10%.
+1% dodge for every point below 35, up to +10%.
When your armor breaks, move 30% faster for 5 s.
Your crew gets the speed boost too.
Enemies are 35% less likely to target you.
+1 concealment for each suppressed weapon you carry, and suppressors cost 2 less concealment.
+8 stability and 100% faster aiming with suppressed weapons.
+3% critical hit chance for every 3 points your detection risk is below 35, up to 30%.
+3% for every point below 35, up to 30%.
Enemies you mark take 15% more damage.
Marks last twice as long. Marked enemies more than 10 m away take a further 50% more damage. Mark specials by aiming at them.
If you lose no armor or health for 4 s, gain +35% critical hit chance for 6 s.
The critical hit bonus lasts 18 s.
Draw and holster pistols in 33% less time.
Pistols hold 5 more rounds per magazine.
+8 more stability with akimbo weapons, and they carry 50% more ammo.
Pistol rounds have a 50% chance to pierce body armor.
Pistol rounds always pierce body armor, and pistols deal 15% more damage.
Each pistol hit gives +10% accuracy for 10 s, stacking 4 times.
Each pistol hit gives +20% pistol damage for 2 s.
You have 50% more health while bleeding out.
You can go down 1 more time before custody.
For 10 s after being revived, reload and swap weapons 100% faster.
For those 10 s you also move 30% faster.
Take 30% less damage for 10 s after being revived.
When you would go down, keep fighting for 3 s first, moving 60% slower.
You keep fighting for 6 s, and your ammo is not used up meanwhile.
While you are down, your bleedout timer pauses whenever no enemy can see you.
While bleeding out, kill an enemy to get back up. 1 charge per heist.
Using a Doctor Bag restores your charge.
Take 50% less damage from melee attacks.
Your melee strikes are 50% more likely to knock enemies down.
Each kill adds +100% damage to your next melee hit, up to +1600%. A melee kill spends it.
A melee kill gives 50% faster reloads for 10 s.
While charging a melee attack, counter enemies that strike you and knock them down.
Below 50% health, deal up to 250% more melee damage the lower your health is.
Ranged weapons gain up to 100% more damage the same way.
Your max health drops to 30% and healing on you is 75% weaker, but you take 10% less damage.
Take 25% less damage instead, and healing is no longer weakened.
